```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(matrixStats)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(data.table)

library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
```

```{r}
other_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Other") |> as.data.frame()
loc_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Locations")  |> as.data.frame()
island_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Islands.UCSC")  |> as.data.frame()
colnames(loc_anno) <- c("CHR","MAPINFO","STRAND")
full_anno <- merge(loc_anno, other_anno, by=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
full_anno <- merge(full_anno, island_anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
rownames(full_anno) <- full_anno$Row.names

#full_anno = full_anno[, c("UCSC_RefGene_Name", "UCSC_RefGene_Accession", "UCSC_RefGene_Group", "Phantom5_Enhancers", "DMR", "X450k_Enhancer", "Regulatory_Feature_Group", "GencodeCompV12_NAME", "GencodeCompV12_Accession", "GencodeCompV12_Group", "DNase_Hypersensitivity_NAME", "DNase_Hypersensitivity_Evidence_Count", "OpenChromatin_NAME", "OpenChromatin_Evidence_Count", "TFBS_NAME", "TFBS_Evidence_Count")]
```


# Data sets used for validation

  - *in-vivo* data sets
     - GSE103186 (Huang et al. Cancer Cell 2017). Human IM / non-IM biopsies. 450K
     - GSE127857 (Gomez et al. Cancers, 2021) Human IM / non-IM (CAG, NAG) / Normal biopsies from antrum 450k

  - *in-vitro* data sets
     - ESGIv1/MB119 IM vs. Normal. Illumina Epic
     - ESGIv2 IM vs. Non-IM. Illumina Epic

  - healthy stomach (KFR)
  - Stomach and intestine from WGBS atlas

```{r}
## Encode H1esc genomic segments#
Segments = read.delim(gzfile("../../../../Data/ExtData/genome_annotation/Encode/wgEncodeBroadHmmH1hescHMM.bed.gz"), header = F)
Segments = subset(Segments, !grepl("Repetitive\\/CNV", V4))
segment_ranges = GRanges(seqnames = Segments$V1, IRanges(start = Segments$V2, end = Segments$V3, names = Segments$V4))
```

```{r}
# Add genomic segmentation labels  
anno_ranges = with(full_anno, GRanges(seqnames = as.character(CHR), IRanges(start = MAPINFO, end = MAPINFO, names = full_anno$Row.names) ) )

seg_ovlp = findOverlaps(segment_ranges, anno_ranges)
full_anno$Seg = NA
full_anno$Seg[subjectHits(seg_ovlp)] = names(segment_ranges[queryHits(seg_ovlp)])
```

## This study, clonal samples

```{r}
evCC_env = new.env()
load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/myNorm_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach_anno_sorted.RData", envir = evCC_env)

load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/myLoad_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach.RData", envir = evCC_env)

```

```{r}
mN_anno_evCC = get("myNorm_anno_sorted", evCC_env)
tmp = get("myLoad", evCC_env)
ed = as.data.frame(tmp$pd)

healthy_stomach_samples <- subset(ed, Project=="KFR_Healthy_Stomach")$Sample_ID
evCC_samples <- subset(ed, Project!="KFR_Healthy_Stomach")$Sample_ID

mN_anno_healthy_stomach <- mN_anno_evCC[,colnames(mN_anno_evCC)[!colnames(mN_anno_evCC) %in% evCC_samples ] ]
ed_healthy_stomach <- ed[rownames(ed)[!rownames(ed) %in% evCC_samples],]

mN_anno_evCC <- mN_anno_evCC[, colnames(mN_anno_evCC)[!colnames(mN_anno_evCC) %in% healthy_stomach_samples ]]
ed <- ed[rownames(ed)[!rownames(ed) %in% healthy_stomach_samples], ]

ed$Cohort = "This study, ex-vivo clonal"
colnames(ed) = gsub("Stomach_site", "Site", gsub("Sample_ID","SampleID",colnames(ed)))
ed = subset(ed, PatientID %in% c("592","594") & Sample_Group %in% c("IM","non-IM"))
ed$Condition = ifelse(ed$Sample_Group=="IM","IM","Non-IM")
ed$sample_label <- paste0(ed$PatientID, "-", ed$Condition, "-",ed$CloneID)

tmp_mat <- as.matrix(mN_anno_evCC[, ed$SampleID])
colnames(tmp_mat) <- ed[colnames(tmp_mat), "sample_label"]
ed[["SampleID"]] <- NULL
colnames(ed) <- gsub("sample_label", "SampleID", colnames(ed))
rownames(ed) <- ed$SampleID
```

```{r}
anno_epic = mN_anno_evCC[, c("CHR","MAPINFO","Strand","Type","gene","feature","cgi","feat.cgi","UCSC_Islands_Name")]
colnames(anno_epic) = gsub("UCSC_Islands_Name","UCSC_CpG_Islands_Name", colnames(anno_epic))

ds_evCC = list(mat = tmp_mat, anno = anno_epic, ed = ed[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort", "Site")])

rm(evCC_env, mN_anno_evCC)
dummy = gc(verbose=F)
```



### Differentially methylated  CpGs between IM and normal stomach in evClonal

FDR < 10% and |logFC| > 0.2

```{r}

load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated.RData")

tmp = all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormal"]]
tmp$comparison = "IMvsNormal"
tmp = subset(tmp, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) >= 0.2)

# all_dm_df = merge(tmp, anno_epic, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
# setorder(all_dm_df, CHR,MAPINFO)
up_ids <- subset(tmp, logFC > 0)$Row.names |> as.character()
down_ids <- subset(tmp, logFC < 0)$Row.names |> as.character()

```


```{r}
# add flags for differentially methylated CpGs
full_anno$DM_evC = ifelse(rownames(full_anno) %in% down_ids, "Hypo", ifelse(rownames(full_anno) %in% up_ids, "Hyper","n.s."))
```

## GSE127857 / Gomez et al.

```{r}
tmp <- readRDS("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE127857/myLoad_GSE127857_batch797x.rds")

mN_anno_tmp = readRDS("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE127857/myNorm_GSE127857_anno_sorted_batch_797x.rds")

ed = tmp$pd |> as.data.frame()

# ed$Cohort = "Gomez et al. biopsies"
# colnames(ed) = gsub("Sample_ID","SampleID",colnames(ed))
# ed$Condition = ifelse(ed$Sample_Group_simple=="IM","IM", ifelse(ed$Sample_Group_simple %in% c("CAG", "NAG"), "Non-IM", "Healthy Antrum") )
# # According to M&M of the article: Only the sample from antrum was selected for the methylation array study to avoid anatomic region-specific methylation.
# ed$Site = "Antrum" 


tmp_mat <- mN_anno_tmp[, ed$Sample_ID] |> as.matrix()
tmp_mat_avg <- limma::avearrays(tmp_mat, ed$Sample_Group_simple)

ed <- data.frame(SampleID = colnames(tmp_mat_avg), Cohort = "Gomez et al. biopsies")
ed$Condition = ifelse(ed$SampleID=="IM","IM", ifelse(ed$SampleID %in% c("CAG", "NAG"), "Non-IM", "Healthy stomach") )
ed$Site = "Antrum"
rownames(ed) <- ed$SampleID

anno_epic = mN_anno_tmp[, c("CHR","MAPINFO","Strand","Type","gene","feature","cgi","feat.cgi","UCSC_Islands_Name")]

#ds_gomez = list(mat = as.matrix(mN_anno_tmp[, ed$SampleID]), anno = anno_epic, ed = ed[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort", "Site")])
ds_gomez = list(mat = tmp_mat_avg, anno = anno_epic, ed = ed[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort","Site")])

rm(mN_anno_tmp,  tmp)
dummy = gc(verbose=F)
```




## GSE220511 / Takeuchi  et al. PMID: 37751933

```{r}
ed <- readRDS("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE220511_IM_nonIM/GSE2205511_Sample_Description.rds")
```

## Polyclonal cohort / ZZ

```{r}
evPC_env = new.env()
load("../../../../Data/Processed/PolyclonalCultures/DNAm/myNorm_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach_anno_sorted.RData", envir = evPC_env)
```

```{r}
mN_anno_pc = get("myNorm_anno_sorted", evPC_env)
ed <- get("ed", evPC_env) |> as.data.frame() |> subset(Project == "ZZU")

ed$Cohort = "This study, ex-vivo polyclonal"
colnames(ed) = gsub("Sample_ID","SampleID",colnames(ed))
ed = subset(ed, Sample_Group %in% c("IM","NON_IM"))
ed$Condition = ifelse(ed$Sample_Group=="IM","IM","Non-IM")
ed$Site = ifelse(ed$Stomach_site == "antrum","Antrum", ifelse(ed$Stomach_site=="junction","Antrum/Corpus","Corpus"))

tmp_mat <- as.matrix(mN_anno_pc[, ed$SampleID])
colnames(tmp_mat) <- ed[colnames(tmp_mat), "Sample_Label"]

rownames(ed) <- ed$Sample_Label
ed2 <- ed[, c("Sample_Label","Condition","Cohort","Site")] |> setNames(c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort","Site"))

anno_epic = mN_anno_pc[, c("CHR","MAPINFO","Strand","Type","gene","feature","cgi","feat.cgi","UCSC_Islands_Name")]
colnames(anno_epic) = gsub("UCSC_Islands_Name","UCSC_CpG_Islands_Name", colnames(anno_epic))
```


```{r}

ds_evPC = list(mat = tmp_mat , anno = anno_epic, ed = ed2)

rm(evPC_env, mN_anno_pc)
dummy = gc(verbose=F)

```

FDR < 10% and |logFC| > 0.2

```{r}
# add flags for differentially methylated CpGs
```

## Huang et al.

```{r}
huang_env = new.env()
load("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE103186_Huang/myNorm_anno_sorted_with_average.RData", envir=huang_env)

load("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE103186_Huang/myLoad.RData", envir=huang_env)
```

```{r}
mL_Huang = get("myLoad", huang_env)

ed_Huang_all = as.data.frame(mL_Huang$pd)
ed = subset(ed_Huang_all, Sample_Group %in% c("IM","Normal") & Site == "Antrum")
rm(mL_Huang)
ed$Cohort = "Huang et al. biopsies"
colnames(ed) = gsub("Sample_Name","SampleID",colnames(ed))
ed$Condition = ifelse(ed$Sample_Group=="IM","IM","Non-IM")

mN_anno_Huang = get("myNorm_anno_sorted", huang_env)
rownames(mN_anno_Huang) = mN_anno_Huang$Row.names

anno_450k = mN_anno_Huang[, c("CHR","MAPINFO","Strand","Type","gene","feature","cgi","feat.cgi","UCSC_CpG_Islands_Name","DHS","Enhancer","Phantom","Probe_SNPs","Probe_SNPs_10")]
rownames(anno_450k) = rownames(mN_anno_Huang)

anno_450k = anno_450k[order(anno_450k$CHR, anno_450k$MAPINFO),]
#anno_450k$DM = ifelse(rownames(anno_450k) %in% unique_dm_ids, "DM","n.s.")

mat_avg = limma::avearrays(as.matrix(mN_anno_Huang[, ed$SampleID]), ed$Condition)

ed2 <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(mat_avg), SampleID=colnames(mat_avg), Condition = colnames(mat_avg), Cohort =  "Huang et al. biopsies", Site = "Antrum" )

#ds_huang = list(mat = as.matrix(mN_anno_Huang[, ed$SampleID]), anno = anno_450k, ed = ed[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort")])

ds_huang = list(mat = mat_avg, anno = anno_450k, ed = ed2[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort","Site")])

rm(huang_env)
dummy=gc(verbose = F)

table(ed$Sample_Group, ed$Site)
```

## Leung IMO data

```{r}
mN_anno_leung <- readRDS("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE210994_Leung_IMO/myNorm_GSE210994_anno_sorted.rds")

mL_leung <- readRDS("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE210994_Leung_IMO/myLoad_GSE210994.rds")
```

```{r}
ed_leung_all = as.data.frame(mL_leung$pd)
#ed = subset(ed_leung_all, Sample_Group %in% c("IM","Normal") & Site == "Antrum")
ed <- ed_leung_all
rm(mL_leung)
ed$Cohort = "Leung IMO"
colnames(ed) = gsub("Sample_ID","SampleID",colnames(ed))

# adapt groups to terms used in other DS
sample_group_translation <- c("Colon" = "Left Colon",
                              "Ileum"="Small intestine", 
                              "IM"="IM",
                              "Healthy_stomach"="Healthy stomach")

ed$Condition = sample_group_translation[ed$Sample_Group_simple]


anno_epic = mN_anno_leung[, c("CHR","MAPINFO","Strand","Type","gene","feature","cgi","feat.cgi","UCSC_Islands_Name")]

anno_epic = anno_epic[order(anno_epic$CHR, anno_epic$MAPINFO),]
#anno_450k$DM = ifelse(rownames(anno_450k) %in% unique_dm_ids, "DM","n.s.")

mat_avg = limma::avearrays(as.matrix(mN_anno_leung[, ed$SampleID]), ed$Condition)

ed2 <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(mat_avg), SampleID=colnames(mat_avg), Cohort =  "Leung IMO" )
ed2$Condition <- ifelse(ed2$SampleID %in% c("IM","Healthy stomach"), ed2$SampleID, "Healthy intestine")
ed2$Site <- ifelse(ed2$SampleID %in% c("IM","Healthy stomach"), "Antrum", ed2$SampleID)


ds_leung = list(mat = mat_avg, anno = anno_epic, ed = ed2[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort","Site")])

rm(leung_env)
dummy=gc(verbose = F)

table(ed$Sample_Group_simple)
```


## WGBS Atlas

```{r}
tmp <- readRDS("../../../../Data/Processed/WGBS/WGS_Cpg_Meth_avg_beta.rds")

mN_avg_wgs <- as.matrix(tmp[!is.na(tmp$ilmn_id), c("Gastric.fundus","Gastric.body","Gastric.antrum","Small.int", "Colon.Left","Colon.Right")])
rownames(mN_avg_wgs) <- tmp[!is.na(tmp$ilmn_id),]$ilmn_id

```

```{r}
sample_to_condition <- c("Gastric.fundus" = "Healthy stomach","Gastric.body"="Healthy stomach","Gastric.antrum"="Healthy stomach","Small.int"="Healthy intestine", "Colon.Left"="Healthy intestine","Colon.Right"="Healthy intestine")
sample_to_site <- c("Gastric.fundus" = "Fundus","Gastric.body"="Corpus","Gastric.antrum"="Antrum","Small.int"="Small intestine", "Colon.Left"="Left Colon","Colon.Right"="Right Colon")
ed <- data.frame(row.names=colnames(mN_avg_wgs), 
                 SampleID = colnames(mN_avg_wgs), 
                 Condition = sample_to_condition[colnames(mN_avg_wgs)],
                 Site = sample_to_site[colnames(mN_avg_wgs)],
                 Cohort = "WGBS")

ds_wgs = list(mat = mN_avg_wgs, anno = anno_epic[rownames(anno_epic) %in% rownames(mN_avg_wgs),], ed = ed[, c("SampleID","Condition","Cohort","Site")])

rm(tmp, mN_avg_wgs)
dummy=gc(verbose = F)

#table(ed$Sample_Group, ed$Site)
```

```{r}
save(ds_evCC, ds_evPC, ds_KFR_IM, ds_huang, ds_leung,  ds_gomez, ds_takeuchi, ds_wgs, ds_healthy, full_anno, file="../../../../Data/Processed/All_Methylation_Validation_DS.RData", compress=T)
```
